verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation on performance at scale or on item and task caps for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. SDK pagination support is a developer building block, not a statement of limits or performance. Community remarks about slow web-app performance are anecdotal, and there is no vendor claim for them to contradict, so they cannot support a 'disputed' verdict.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
